title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The API map catches up
gist.blurb: The API reference has caught up with the deployed OpenAPI spec. Even maps of the garden need tending.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the OpenAPI spec after a production deploy, bringing the published API reference in line with the deployed spec.
gist.impact: Developers reading APIDOCS.md now have a reference synchronized with the production OpenAPI spec.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends an open API reference book beside a glowing terminal, with small code-plants growing around the pages; a friendly CRT monitor robot helps compare the book with the deployed spec. The scene represents documentation catching up with what is running, without implying a particular endpoint changed.
